note: The riposte's victim: the reaction from the blade's entry (frame 10 of T_1HRIPOSTE) through the hold to the pull (frame 21), then a short stagger back; the engine hands the body to the knockdown ragdoll after the pull. Body-only prompts, the 1H combat stance at the start, no end key. Travel in metres in the character's frame (x = its left, z = forward), 30 fps.

moves.text: A person is stabbed in the stomach, flinches and doubles over in pain, hunched forward, and holds still.
A dazed person is stabbed in the stomach, doubles over in pain and staggers half a step backward.
